interpretation.note: The deployed model is 'exact_optimum': a per-block mixed-integer linear program that solves the capacity-constrained assignment to proven optimality (reduction=27.63%). It dominates the greedy per-lot heuristic ('oracle'=12.19%) by 15.44pp because it allocates scarce low-emission capacity across the whole operational block instead of consuming it on early lots. The neuroevolution policy ('neat'=11.31%) and a fixed LINEAR policy trained with the SAME fitness function ('linear_fitness'=9.64%) land within 1.67pp of each other: topology augmentation adds little in this first-order simulator, confirming the auditor's intuition that the problem does not require a deep learned model. Supervised logistic regression ('logistic_reg'=-12.78%) underperforms because per-row label imitation ignores sequential capacity depletion. NEAT is therefore reported as a learned-policy benchmark, while the exact optimizer is the deployed decision engine.
